subject: MAP checkpoint — security & compliance: evidence handoff, audit logs, pen-test scope
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Holmes <claire.holmes@acmecorp.com>, security@acme-corp.com
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: MAP checkpoint — security & compliance: evidence handoff, audit logs, pen-test scope

Team — kicking off this week's MAP checkpoint for Acme (RDW-3257). Goal: confirm owners, what evidence we can handoff this week, and finalize pen-test scope so Acme's procurement can close. High level asks from Acme in the last sync: SOC 2 artifact list, sample audit logs showing retention/rotation, and a short statement on our third‑party pentest timeline.

Open items (please update owner + ETA inline):
- SOC 2 evidence matrix: list of artifacts + responsible owner (owner: Laura?) — ETA: EOD 11/06
- DPA redline status: legal comments to share with Acme (owner: Jonas) — ETA: 11/08
- Audit log sample (retention policy + one-week sample extract) (owner: Rishi) — ETA: 11/05 (today)
- Pen-test scope and timing (coord w/ Pentest vendor) (owner: Rishi to coordinate) — ETA: 11/12

Attachments I'll drop to the folder: SOC2-evidence_matrix.xlsx (stub). Meeting: I propose a 30-min sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to walk through any gaps.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Director, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Thanks Jonas — quick updates: 
- I'll finalize the SOC 2 evidence matrix this afternoon and upload to the shared Drive (SOC2-evidence_matrix.xlsx attached as stub). It will include owners for each control and links to artifacts.
- For the DPA, legal sent initial comments yesterday; I'll pull the tracked PDF and add it to the folder for your review (Jonas).
- Suggest we mark the retention policy as 90 days for the current proof-of-concept, with an action to propose enterprise retention options post-contract.

I can join the 10:00am PT sync tomorrow.

—Laura

From: Claire Holmes <claire.holmes@acmecorp.com>

Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint — security & compliance: evidence handoff, audit logs, pen-test scope

Jonas/Laura/Rishi — thanks for the note. A few clarifications from Acme security: 
1) Audit logs — can you provide a one‑week sample (redacted) showing retention headers and an example of the log rotation policy? We need to demonstrate chain-of-custody for one user session.
2) Pen-test — Acme's procurement requires confirmation that pentest windows won't overlap with our production deployments; also please confirm the point-of-contact at the vendor (we use PenWorks).
3) DPA — legal will want to see your tracked changes and an SLA excerpt for data deletion timelines.

I've attached the Acme questionnaire — can you confirm which items you'll answer this week?

Thanks,
Claire Holmes
Sr. InfoSec Manager, Acme Corp
[attachment: acme-security-questionnaire.pdf (pdf, 450KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Holmes <claire.holmes@acmecorp.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 15:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP checkpoint — security & compliance: evidence handoff, audit logs, pen-test scope

On Thu, Nov 5, 2026 at 12:40 PM Claire Holmes <claire.holmes@acmecorp.com> wrote:
> Jonas/Laura/Rishi — thanks for the note. A few clarifications from Acme security: 
> 1) Audit logs — can you provide a one‑week sample (redacted) showing retention headers and an example of the log rotation policy?

Claire — attaching a redacted sample (audit-logs-sample.txt) showing timestamp, user_id hash, event_type, and retention metadata. For chain-of-custody we include an ingest timestamp and S3 object version header in the export. Our retention policy for the POC environment is 90 days; enterprise options (365/730) are on the roadmap and we can include that language in the DPA.

PenWorks contact: penworks.ops@pentestvendor.com — I've looped them onto the thread to confirm availability. We'll ensure tests are scheduled during a predefined maintenance window and provide a POC contact to coordinate.

Deliverables I'll upload today: audit-logs-sample.txt (stub), brief pentest-runbook doc w/ vendor POC and blackout windows.

—Rishi
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
[attachment: audit-logs-sample.txt (txt, 18KB)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

- Laura: finalize SOC2 matrix and upload by EOD 11/06 (owner: laura_bennett).
- Rishi: upload audit log sample + pentest runbook today and confirm vendor POC (owner: rishi_malhotra).
- Jonas: share DPA redline with Acme legal by 11/08 and surface SLA excerpt for data deletion (owner: jonas_weber).
- PenWorks: please confirm available windows week of 11/15 and your POC contact on the thread.

I'll run the 30-min sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to walk through gaps; invite sent. If anything slips, flag in the MAP so procurement isn't blocked.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking to close commercial terms by 11/19.

Jonas
